brand.name: Qalam.ai
brand.logo_concept: Minimalist geometric pen nib merged with an open book, sharp lines. No generic AI sparkles.
brand.emotional_tone: Authoritative, premium, trustworthy, and warm. Designed to make teachers feel empowered, not replaced.

theme.description: Ink and Amber. A deep navy/ink anchor for structure and authority, paired with a vibrant warm amber for engagement and warmth.

spacing_and_layout.general: Generous spacing. Use p-8 to p-12 for dashboard cards. Modular bento grid layouts for the teacher dashboard.
spacing_and_layout.rtl_guidelines: Use Tailwind logical properties (e.g., 'start', 'end', 'ps', 'pe', 'ms', 'me', 'border-s') exclusively instead of physical properties ('left', 'right', 'pl', 'pr', 'border-l') to ensure flawless LTR to RTL transition.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Mode B (Control Room): grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Gap-6. Cardless or minimal 1px border cards. Use direct children.

motion.hover_states: Crisp lift (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow increase. No bouncy animations. Ensure focus states have high contrast.
motion.live_quiz: High energy entrance animations for questions. Timer ring smooth countdown. Must respect prefers-reduced-motion.

component_instructions.buttons: Sharp corners or subtle rounded (rounded-md). High contrast. Primary buttons in Ink (light mode) or Amber (dark mode). Always define hover text color.
component_instructions.cards: Subtle 1px border. No soft, muddy shadows. If shadow is used, it should be crisp. Apply optical alignment for inner content.
component_instructions.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 or bg-[#0B132B]/70) for marketing. Solid bg for dashboard. Must include language switcher (EN/AR).
component_instructions.forms: Use Shadcn UI forms. Sharp borders, high contrast focus states (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent).
component_instructions.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include 'data-testid' attribute (e.g. data-testid="login-submit-btn").

key_page_layouts.landing: Hero section with large typographic hook. Social proof logos. Asymmetrical bento grid for features (AI extraction, Auto grading). Maximum image height 80vh on mobile. Max overlay bg-black/50.
key_page_layouts.teacher_dashboard: Mini-sidebar. Top stats row (Total Classes, Quizzes Generated, etc.). Recent activity feed. Quick actions block.
key_page_layouts.pdf_upload: Drag and drop zone with dashed border. Document grid with metadata. Use Shadcn card.
key_page_layouts.live_quiz_presenter: Fullscreen. Massive typography (text-6xl+). 4 colored blocks for answers. Live participant counter badge. Timer ring.
key_page_layouts.student_join: Ultra-minimalist. Big bold input field for 6-digit code. Centered layout.

hero_background.description: Teacher standing in front of blackboard - use with dark ink gradient overlay

instructions_to_main_agent: Install fonts: Cabinet Grotesk, Tajawal, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Sans Arabic.
Set up Tailwind dark mode support using CSS variables (HSL).
Implement language switching state, dynamically applying 'dir="rtl"' on the <html> or root container when Arabic is selected.
Use Tailwind logical properties exclusively (e.g., 'start-0', 'ms-4', 'pe-6') for spacing, borders, and positioning.
Ensure the Live Quiz Presenter Mode is a fullscreen, immersive layout separate from the main dashboard structure.
Use Shadcn UI components heavily customized to match the Swiss & High-Contrast Archetype (sharp, crisp, authoritative).
